name: Attachment Transfer
description: Attachments (images, binaries) transfer with progress, resume, and integrity verification.
purpose: Provide reliable, resumable attachment transfer with progress reporting and integrity verification suitable for images and binaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Attachments are transferred via chunked HTTP or WebSocket streaming.
Transfer reports progress (bytes transferred, total, estimated time).
Interrupted transfers resume from the last verified chunk.
Integrity is verified via SHA-256 hash of the complete file.
Large attachments use chunk-level hashes for partial resume verification.
